doc.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020

title: Gerald Wilson and Snooky Young; favorite lead trumpeters; goodbye
summary: Shew recalls playing with Snooky Young in Wilson, Bellson, Berry and Juggernaut bands, names his three favorite lead players, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: I’m going to recommend one for you.
Gerald Wilson and Snooky Young sitting together.

Well for me, I was on Gerald’s band playing the lead chair for a while, and then Snooky Young stood next to me on Louie Bellson’s band for a long time and he was also, we were in Bill Berry’s band together and also in the Juggernaut, Nat Pierce/Frank Capp band together. I love Snooky. My three favorite lead trumpet players in the world are Snooky, Al Porcino and Conrad Gozzo. Anybody that’s going to learn to play lead trumpet better study those three guys because everybody else comes from those three. © Fillius Jazz Archive -19-
Thank you very much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
